sql: SELECT s.relname AS t, s.n_live_tup AS rows, s.n_tup_ins AS ins, s.n_tup_upd AS upd, s.n_tup_del AS del, (xpath('/row/m/text()', q.x))[1]::text AS last_created, (xpath('/row/n/text()', q.x))[1]::text AS n30 FROM pg_stat_user_tables s LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT query_to_xml(format('SELECT max(created_at)::date AS m, count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at > now() - interval ''30 days'') AS n FROM public.%I', s.relname), false, true, '') AS x WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns ic WHERE ic.table_schema = 'public' AND ic.table_name = s.relname AND ic.column_name = 'created_at')) q ON true WHERE s.schemaname = 'public' ORDER BY s.relname
